# Mohammed Maher – Creative Visual Designer Portfolio (Full Reference)

## Site Identity
- **Name**: Mohammed Maher | Creative Visual Designer
- **URL**: https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/
- **Primary Language**: English (default on `/` and `/en/`)
- **Secondary Language**: Arabic RTL (available on `/ar/`)

## Purpose
Personal portfolio website showcasing professional design work, creative philosophy, skills, and career journey. Aimed at potential clients, recruiters, and collaborators in the design industry.

## Homepage Sections (scroll-driven single page)

### Hero
Full-screen introductory section with designer name, tagline, and call-to-action buttons linking to Selected Work and Contact.

### Selected Work
Three featured projects displayed as large immersive cards with project images, titles, categories, and links to full case studies.

### About
Personal biography, design approach, and portrait image. Covers design philosophy: intentional, human-centered, detail-oriented work.

### Skills & Expertise
- **Software proficiency**: Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, Cinema 4D, Procreate, Canva, Notion
- **Expertise areas**: Brand Identity & Strategy, Digital & UI Design, Print & Publication Design, Motion & Video, Illustration, Photography
- **Design Principles**: Purpose-Driven, Detail-Obsessed, Culturally Aware, Collaborative

### Creative Journey
Timeline of career milestones: education, early work, client projects, and growth moments.

### Contact
Contact form for inquiries. Fields: name, email, subject, message.

## Project Gallery
Full filterable gallery of all published projects. Filterable by category. Each project has:
- Title and slug
- Featured image
- Category tags
- Full artwork gallery
- Description and case study

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 19.0.0, Vite 6, TailwindCSS v4, GSAP with ScrollTrigger
- **Rendering**: Server-Side Rendered (SSR) with pre-rendered static HTML for English and Arabic
- **Backend**: Laravel 11 (PHP 8.3), MySQL via Aiven, deployed on Render
- **CDN**: Cloudinary for all project images
- **Deployment**: Vercel (frontend), Render (API backend)
- **i18n**: English (en) default, Arabic (ar) with full RTL layout

## SEO
- Sitemap: https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/robots.txt
- Canonical URLs: https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/ (English), https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/ar/ (Arabic)
- Meta: Unique title/description per locale and per project page

## Contact & Social
- Contact form: https://mohammed-design.vercel.app/#contact
- Portfolio admin: Private (not publicly accessible)
